decisions.reason: As a close-to-core compliance tool with several models, its own page, and at least some positive agency feedback, management is likely to justify its investment and treat any weaker uptake as temporary.
Because it is a flagship platform on the homepage and central to the firm’s announced agency-focused direction, the public commitment and likely development effort make withdrawal very unlikely.
This managed hosting plan fits the established business closely, so management is likely to retain it and adjust positioning or features rather than admit failure after a recent launch.
